data_fields.name: step_distance
data_fields.donor_constant: per call, set in QuakeC (not read)

best_idea: When a creature's direct step is blocked, try the diagonal, then the axes, then its current heading, then a sweep, and reverse last, so it slides around an obstacle instead of turning straight back.
decision_why: The try order and the no-reversal rule fit a zone where creatures crowd and get stuck, but the donor steers on eight 1996 grid headings with rand() and a 215 diagonal quirk, so Frankendom should keep the order, use a steering vector on its own arena or navmesh query, and draw the rolls from the seeded fight RNG.
acceptance: A player sees a creature blocked by a pillar slide around it within a few steps rather than standing still or turning straight back; a server test on a fixed blocked map asserts the try order and that the same seed gives the same path.
